text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Bouquetd'or agreed to teach 
us 
how to brew tea using the flowers and 
herbs 
she learned about at that event.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Since you enjoy wild herb tea too, Daring 
Tact— 
I wondered if you might like to join us.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Most of them are teas meant to be enjoyed 
visually— 
though we will also prepare teas using 
wild blossoms like dandelions.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
My teas usually prioritize medicinal 
benefits. 
I would love to try making tea that 
pleases the eye as well!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay, so glad~♡ And hey, hey, 
do you mind if I film it 
and stream it to my community?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you have had me on your streams 
several times before. 
I have no objection at all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—I'm currently practicing how to fillet 
salmon, 
so I figured I might as well master 
cooking it too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, do you know how to make 
authentic salmon chanchan-yaki? 
Whenever I search online, I only find 
modified recipes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Building a campfire 
and grilling it on a massive iron griddle 
is the traditional method!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
An iron griddle...! 
Would you mind teaching me how to make it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
With pleasure. I would love for you to 
taste the authentic flavor!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, remember that manga you 
wanted to read? 
My family texted me this morning saying 
they shipped it. 
It should be arriving in a few days!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Really?! 
You mean the one about retreating into 
mountains around the world to train—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's the one! The manga where they 
embark on a training journey 
seeking harsh environments to become the 
strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the protagonist sounds just like 
Titleholder, 
so I have been curious about it for a 
while. I cannot wait.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we invite 
Titleholder and have a reading party? 
Talking about it totally made me want to 
read it again too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds lovely! 
I am sure Titleholder would love that as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I heard you are also attending the 
upcoming party, Efforia. 
Regarding our prior promise—

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Our promise to assist one another 
in selecting new formal attire for the 
party, correct?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I tend to pick the same style every 
time, 
so I would love for us to choose outfits 
for each other...!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I feel the same way. Whenever it 
is convenient for you, 
Daring Tact, I would be delighted to 
accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This weekend is picking formalwear with 
Efforia, 
next is with Almond Eye... Ah, oh dear...

As it turned out, Daring Tact had 
scheduled 
far too many plans with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I did wonder if my schedule might get a 
bit crowded, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't had many chances to hang out 
with friends my own age like this before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I ended up getting greedy. 
But... they all sound so fun, I want to do 
every single one.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Then there's no reason to give up on a 
single thing!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna enjoy it all, just enjoy it 
all! 
Leave it to me, Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make you, and everyone else, 
happy all at once!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, thanks for gathering, everyone! 
Today is our 'Enjoy Everything Together' 
party!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All the things Daring Tact promised to do, 
let's do every single one of 'em 
together!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The salmon chanchan-yaki is ready! 
Please help yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that miso smells wonderful♪ 
Such a pity we can't share the aroma on 
stream.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Delicious, so this is authentic flavor...! 
As expected, the secret is that exquisite 
heat control?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Controlling the heat with firewood is 
tricky, 
but the result is completely different 
from gas.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To accompany our meal—tea is essential, 
isn't it? 
Allow me to brew some flower tea for 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll help you! 
Please tell me all about herbal flower 
teas.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Flower tea? I wanna watch you brew it too! 
It might give me ideas for my manga!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My, looks like everyone's full of 
curiosity. 
Take it away, Instructor Bouquet~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Titleholder, don't tell me... 
are you doing the same training as the 
manga while reading it?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm on volume 15 now. 
Mountain retreat in the Southern Alps.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What an innovative way to read...! But it 
must be effective. 
Alright, I shall join in—!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I tried on the outfit that Epiphaneia 
picked out for me. 
How does it look?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It looks great! Gives you a slightly more 
mature vibe, Tact! 
And bright yellow looks fantastic on 
Efforia too! Absolutely stunning!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Yellow... It's not a color I would 
normally pick. 
It was thanks to Daring Tact's discerning 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—And so, thanks to Epiphaneia, I was able 
to enjoy 
every single activity with everyone in 
just one day!
choice_data_list:
Enjoying everything all at once like 
that... You're pretty tough.

Enjoying everything all at once like 
that... You sure are tough.

Fun and efficient at the same time—sounds 
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:

to enjoy 
every single activity with everyone in 
just one day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it was such a delightful time. 
I didn't feel tired at all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can spend time with everyone, 
I could keep having fun forever—no matter 
how many hours pass!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Doing everything all at once... 
Even if you could think of it, pulling it 
off is no simple task.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yet she made it a reality. 
I would expect nothing less from 
Epiphaneia!
